#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Offline Day8 closed E1/M1 control with definite nuclear parity relaxed.

Only synthetic Ji=Jf=1/2, one common photon mode/energy, diagonal initial rho.
No Hamiltonian, nucleus, parity-violating interaction, physical energy or data
is assigned. Source amplitudes retain conjugation for complex controls.
Default is read-only; --write-receipt exclusively creates one authorized JSON.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
CODE_REL = "tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/nondefinite-parity-control/nondefinite_parity_control.py"
RUN_REL = "outputs/learning-daily/20261007-DAY8-angular-momentum-selection-rules-multipolarity-run-01"
RECEIPT_REL = RUN_REL + "/nondefinite-parity-control.json"
OLD_BUDGET_REL = RUN_REL + "/controlled-four-mode-truncation.json"
OLD_BUDGET_SHA = "0ba57d1ebd21294ecbcbccd365fa3e984215116542cb6b8676a57f6b7e527aae"
RB_RAW = "raw/papers/gpt/high-spin-20260920/multipolarity/mixing ratio/1967_Rose et al_Angular Distributions of Gamma Rays in Terms of Phase-Defined Reduced Matrix Elements.pdf"
RB_SHA = "8f846b61b9320de291ee5600126c5e286a0fe05968df819696816f0dc1ec57dc"
LKH_RAW = "raw/papers/gpt/high-spin-20260920/review/1982_Lange et al_E0-E2-M1 multipole admixtures of transitions in even-even nuclei.pdf"
LKH_SHA = "ed925a0577a9257903806acd209c1db707529e86a5bfd9a301a83d597bf78ffb"
RB_IMAGES = [
    "tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/p312-pdf7.png",
    "tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/p316-pdf11.png",
    "tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/p317-pdf12.png",
    "tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/p318-pdf13.png",
    "tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/p320-pdf15.png",
    "tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/p321-pdf16.png",
]


def digest(path: Path) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def build_receipt(root: Path) -> dict:
    dep_rel = "tmp/day8-20261007/rose-brink/python-deps"
    sys.path.insert(0, str(root/dep_rel))
    import sympy as sp
    from sympy.physics.wigner import clebsch_gordan, wigner_d_small
    counts: Counter[str] = Counter()

    def check(name, condition):
        if not bool(condition):
            raise AssertionError(name)
        counts[name] += 1

    def eq(a, b):
        return sp.simplify(a-b) == 0

    def exact(e):
        return str(sp.factor(sp.simplify(e)))

    def matrix_text(m):
        return [[exact(m[i,j]) for j in range(m.cols)] for i in range(m.rows)]

    check("RB_raw_identity", digest(root/RB_RAW)==RB_SHA)
    check("LKH_raw_identity", digest(root/LKH_RAW)==LKH_SHA)
    check("old_budget_immutable_before", digest(root/OLD_BUDGET_REL)==OLD_BUDGET_SHA)
    run=json.loads((root/RUN_REL/"run.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    check("day_index_retained", run["day_index"]==8)

    c, st, p, a, b = sp.symbols("c st p a b", real=True)
    theta=sp.symbols("theta", real=True)
    j=sp.Rational(1,2)
    eta=a+sp.I*b
    S=1+a*a+b*b
    v=2*a/S
    Ms=[-j,j]
    qs=[-1,1]
    weights={m:(1+2*m*p)/2 for m in Ms}
    B={K:sp.simplify(sum(weights[m]*(-1)**(j-m)*sp.sqrt(2)*clebsch_gordan(j,j,K,m,-m,0) for m in Ms)) for K in [0,1]}
    check("source_B0",B[0]==1)
    check("source_B1_orientation",B[1]==p)
    check("population_trace_one",sum(weights.values())==1)
    check("CG_coupled_norm_each_initial_M",all(sum(clebsch_gordan(j,1,j,mf,mi-mf,mi)**2 for mf in Ms)==1 for mi in Ms))

    # Source footnote7 uses exp(-i theta Jy). Rodrigues follows Jy^3=Jy.
    Jy=sp.Matrix([[0,-sp.I/sp.sqrt(2),0],[sp.I/sp.sqrt(2),0,-sp.I/sp.sqrt(2)],[0,sp.I/sp.sqrt(2),0]])
    d=sp.simplify(sp.eye(3)-sp.I*st*Jy+(c-1)*Jy*Jy)
    check("Jy_Hermitian",Jy==Jy.conjugate().T)
    check("Jy_minimal_polynomial",Jy**3==Jy)
    ds=wigner_d_small(1,-theta)
    dtrig=d.subs({c:sp.cos(theta),st:sp.sin(theta)})
    check("source_rotation_matches_SymPy_minus_theta",all(sp.trigsimp(sp.expand_trig(x-y))==0 for x,y in zip(ds,dtrig)))

    def reduce_angle(expr):
        return sp.factor(sp.expand(expr).subs(st**2,1-c*c))

    def source_H(aE,aM):
        scale=sp.simplify(sp.conjugate(aE)*aE+sp.conjugate(aM)*aM)
        if scale==0:
            raise ValueError("empty photon model")
        Hraw=sp.zeros(2)
        paths=[]
        for mi in Ms:
            for mf in Ms:
                m=mi-mf
                row=sp.Matrix([sp.sqrt(sp.Rational(3,2))*(aE+q*aM)*clebsch_gordan(j,1,j,mf,m,mi)*d[1-m,1-q] for q in qs])
                Hraw+=weights[mi]*row*row.conjugate().T
                paths.append({"Mi":exact(mi),"Mf":exact(mf),"m":exact(m),"amplitudes_before_common_sqrt_S_division":[exact(e) for e in row]})
        return (Hraw/scale).applyfunc(reduce_angle),paths

    H,paths=source_H(sp.Integer(1),eta)
    I={q:H[i,i] for i,q in enumerate(qs)}
    W=sp.simplify(sp.trace(H))
    check("full_helicity_matrix_Hermitian",H==H.conjugate().T)
    for q in qs:
        check("source_helicity_intensity_sign",eq(I[q],(1+q*v)*(1+q*p*c)/2))
    check("source_qplus_axis_anchor",eq(H[1,1].subs({c:1}),weights[j]*(1+v)))
    check("source_qminus_axis_anchor",eq(H[0,0].subs({c:1}),weights[-j]*(1-v)))
    check("helicity_offdiagonal_zero",H[0,1]==0 and H[1,0]==0)
    check("unpolarized_W_closed_form",eq(W,1+p*v*c))
    check("odd_K_coefficient",eq(sp.diff(W,c),2*p*a/S))
    check("angular_average_one",eq(sp.integrate(W,(c,-1,1))/2,1))
    integrated={q:sp.simplify(sp.integrate(I[q],(c,-1,1))/2) for q in qs}
    for q in qs:
        check("integrated_helicity_fraction",eq(integrated[q],(1+q*v)/2))
    check("raw_total_width_only_S",eq(sp.integrate(S*W,(c,-1,1))/2,S))
    check("raw_E_M_cross_cancels_after_helicity_sum",eq((1+eta)*(1+sp.conjugate(eta))+(1-eta)*(1-sp.conjugate(eta)),2*S))
    check("v_absolute_value_at_most_one_SOS",eq(S*S-4*a*a,((a-1)**2+b*b)*((a+1)**2+b*b)))

    jx=sp.Matrix([1,-1])/sp.sqrt(2)
    jy=sp.Matrix([1,1])/sp.sqrt(2)
    Ix=sp.simplify((jx.conjugate().T*H*jx)[0])
    Iy=sp.simplify((jy.conjugate().T*H*jy)[0])
    check("source_Jones_x_intensity",eq(Ix,W/2))
    check("source_Jones_y_intensity",eq(Iy,W/2))
    check("linear_difference_zero",Ix-Iy==0)
    Pcircle=sp.cancel((I[1]-I[-1])/W)
    check("circular_P_closed_form",eq(Pcircle,(v+p*c)/(1+v*p*c)))
    check("circular_P_bounded_where_W_positive",eq((1+v*p*c)**2-(v+p*c)**2,(1-v*v)*(1-p*p*c*c)))

    # General helicity-sum selector in Eq3.40: diagonals have even K, cross E/M
    # has odd K for the same L. The complex extension is obtained via A A^dagger.
    selector={}
    for K in [0,1]:
        selector[str(K)]={}
        for label,pi,pip in [("EE",0,0),("MM",1,1),("EM",0,1),("ME",1,0)]:
            val=1+(-1)**(2+pi+pip-K)
            selector[str(K)][label]=val
            expected=2 if (K==0 and pi==pip) or (K==1 and pi!=pip) else 0
            check("source_even_odd_selector",val==expected)

    pureE,_=source_H(sp.Integer(1),sp.Integer(0))
    pureM,_=source_H(sp.Integer(0),sp.Integer(1))
    check("pure_E_odd_null_for_any_p",eq(sp.trace(pureE),1))
    check("pure_M_odd_null_for_any_p",eq(sp.trace(pureM),1))
    check("pure_E_and_M_same_Jhalf_helicity_matrix",pureE==pureM)
    check("alignment_p0_nonzero_mix_W_isotropic",W.subs(p,0)==1)
    check("alignment_p0_circular_can_be_nonzero",eq(Pcircle.subs({p:0,a:sp.Rational(1,2),b:0}),sp.Rational(4,5)))
    check("quadrature_complex_phase_odd_null",W.subs(a,0)==1)
    check("quadrature_complex_phase_circular_orientation",eq(Pcircle.subs(a,0),p*c))
    check("p_sign_flip_reverses_A1",eq(W.subs(p,-p),1-p*v*c))
    check("eta_sign_flip_reverses_A1",eq(W.subs({a:-a,b:-b}),1-p*v*c))
    check("simultaneous_p_eta_sign_flip_same_W",eq(W.subs({p:-p,a:-a,b:-b},simultaneous=True),W))
    check("simultaneous_p_eta_sign_flip_reverses_Pcircle",eq(Pcircle.subs({p:-p,a:-a,b:-b},simultaneous=True),-Pcircle))
    check("eta_conjugation_blind_in_this_model",H.subs(b,-b)==H)

    positive={p:sp.Rational(1,2),a:sp.Rational(1,2),b:0}
    Wpositive=sp.simplify(W.subs(positive))
    check("positive_control_A1_two_fifths",eq(Wpositive,1+sp.Rational(2,5)*c))
    check("node_W_zero",W.subs({p:1,a:1,b:0,c:-1})==0)
    check("node_circular_numerator_also_zero",(I[1]-I[-1]).subs({p:1,a:1,b:0,c:-1})==0)

    # A legitimate response on the same healthy isotropic source can mimic only
    # the unpolarized profile. No actual response/data or new nuclear case.
    bdet,e0=sp.symbols("b_det e0",real=True)
    efficiency=e0*(1+bdet*c)
    accepted_mean=sp.integrate(efficiency,(c,-1,1))/2
    accepted_profile=sp.cancel(efficiency/accepted_mean)
    check("response_acceptance_mean_e0",accepted_mean==e0)
    check("response_profile_normalization",sp.integrate(accepted_profile,(c,-1,1))/2==1)
    check("response_mimics_odd_shape",accepted_profile==1+bdet*c)
    control_eff=efficiency.subs({bdet:sp.Rational(2,5),e0:sp.Rational(1,2)})
    check("response_control_positive_lower_endpoint",control_eff.subs(c,-1)==sp.Rational(3,10))
    check("response_control_upper_endpoint_below_one",control_eff.subs(c,1)==sp.Rational(7,10))
    check("response_control_profile_matches_coherent_control",eq(accepted_profile.subs(bdet,sp.Rational(2,5)),Wpositive))
    check("old_budget_immutable_after",digest(root/OLD_BUDGET_REL)==OLD_BUDGET_SHA)

    codepath=Path(__file__).resolve()
    return {
